diagnosis.root_cause: Model assumes uniform BRCA status across all bins
diagnosis.reality: Tumors have subclonal BRCA — mixed sensitive and resistant
evidence: BRCA2 mutation frequency 8% even in selected population
Subclonal heterogeneity means not all cells equally BRCA-deficient
Combined resistance rate >> BRCA reversion alone

what_is_needed.description: Two-layer model: continuous resistance phenotype (x) PLUS binary BRCA status
what_is_needed.approach: Each bin splits into BRCA-deficient (low EC50) and BRCA-proficient (high EC50)
what_is_needed.this_is: A 2x20 = 40-compartment model, not fundamentally different from current architecture

honest_status: Cannot validate PROfound with current model. Architecture extension needed.
what_model_CANNOT_validate_yet: Continuous therapy with acquired resistance (olaparib, enzalutamide)
